gap: No result ChatGPT got gives a dated maker-store price for the TESmart HKS201-P23 ($129.99 on tesmart.com, 2026-11-10) or says that TESmart lists EDID emulation and hotkey, mouse-wheel, button and IR switching for it. itechguides says the UGREEN HDMI KVM listing supports neither EDID emulation nor hotkeys, so the $60–75 extra buys exactly those two missing features.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited pages. DeskDNA (cited, 'Reviewed September 2026') lists UGREEN HDMI KVM $70, TESmart DP 1.4 4K144 $160 (model not named), Cable Matters USB-C dock $200 and UGREEN USB switch $40. Its prices carry no date, it never mentions the HKS201-P23, and it names EDID emulation only for its TESmart DP pick. itechguides (cited) prices only Amazon listings ($69.99 UGREEN, $19.99 Heravo, $26.99 Hearvo, $59.99 ATLAHET) and says the UGREEN listing has no EDID emulation and no hotkeys. It names no TESmart single-monitor HDMI model and gives no TESmart prices. Neither page sets the UGREEN against the HKS201-P23 on EDID emulation and switching methods at dated maker prices, and neither names a TESmart HDMI 2.1 option between the $130 and $450 tiers.
decides: This confirms UGREEN as the budget pick only if the shopper accepts windows rearranging on switch and pressing a button to switch. The HKS201-P23 at $129.99 is the step-up that fixes both. For a 144 Hz+ monitor, ChatGPT's StarTech at $449.85 comes from a Canadian retailer I could not open. TESmart's own single-monitor HDMI 2.1 HKS201-M24 is $269.00 and lists 3840×2160@240Hz (DSC), VRR and EDID emulation, but both PCs need HDMI 2.1 outputs.
